verdict.rationale: Plaid is a financial-data and payments API platform, not an agent or AI host that consumes external tools, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error for this kind of product. The pack's MCP evidence describes Plaid hosting its own Dashboard MCP server for other agents (the server role). That does not show Plaid acting as an MCP client, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
